P.text: injectSweepAndCall is intended to execute only via delegatecall in a user wallet/shim context where address(this) is the wallet, but it is declared as a normal external function without an onlyDelegatecall or equivalent restriction
P.evidence_quote: the function is declared as a normal external function without any onlyDelegatecall or equivalent restriction

I.text: the function should be restricted to delegatecall-only execution so address(this) and _getSelfBalance refer to the user's wallet/shim rather than the router contract
I.evidence_quote: The core faulty assumption is that “this function will only ever execute in a context where address(this) is a wallet (or shim) owned by the user”

V.text: when called directly on the router, it transfers tokens from msg.sender into address(this) (the router) and uses the router's own balance, causing the router to accumulate and control user funds, with potential fund loss and drainability via the previously reported bug
V.evidence_quote: When called directly on the router contract, it transfers tokens from msg.sender into address(this) (the router), and subsequent internal logic uses the router’s own balance via _getSelfBalance / address(this).
